_note: Image registry. src is a local path (relative to repo root) or a remote URL. npm run images downloads, crops, grades and converts each entry to AVIF and WebP at several widths into static/assets/img/<id>/ and records it in images.manifest.json. The site never hotlinks: an image missing from the manifest renders as a quiet placeholder.
